The '''rune essence mine''' is a [[mine]] only accessible by being teleported there by various [[NPC]]s, and it is one of two locations where [[Rune essence|rune]] and [[pure essence]] can be mined; the other being the [[Lunar Isle Mine]]. It is only accessible after [[Rune Mysteries]]. Unlike the one located on [[Lunar Isle]], this mine cannot be reached manually by players, due to it being sealed from all access except a specific spell.

==History==
At some point, the [[Stone of Jas]] resided in the mine, which resulted in the formation of [[Rune Essence (rock)|large deposits]] of [[rune essence]].

Before the mine was re-discovered at the start of the [[Fifth Age]], the use of [[Runecrafting]] and [[Magic]] was very limited due to the scarcity of runes and rune essence. Its discovery allowed magic to be freely used once more, and resulted in the creation of the first [[Wizards' Tower]] as well as the [[Order of Wizards]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|loc=Rune Mysteries|quote=The rediscovery of runecrafting had such a large impact on the world, that it marked the dawn of the Fifth Age. It also resulted in the birth of our order, and the construction of the first Wizards' Tower.}} However, decades later in the Year 70 of the Fifth Age, a Zamorakian mage had a breakthrough in [[teleport]]ation [[spells]] magic, but the Saradominist wizards of the Order of Wizards purportedly stole it. They attempted a ritual using this breakthrough, but due to not understanding the magic, failed, and burned down the Wizards' Tower losing years of research, including the incantation to teleport to the essence mine.{{CiteNPC|npc=Mage of Zamorak|quote=A Zamorakian wizard made a great breakthrough in teleportation magic, but the Saradominists stole his research. They used it to perform a ritual, but their lack of understanding caused it to go wrong. The entire Wizards' Tower burnt down. Many were killed, and years of research was destroyed.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|loc=Rune Mysteries|quote=When the tower burnt down, much was lost, including an important incantation. A spell that could be used to teleport to a hidden essence mine.}} The Saradominist wizards blamed the Zamorakian wizards for the failure, and banished them from the Order, leading them to form the [[Zamorak Magical Institute]]. Eventually, the [[Player character|player]] assisted [[Archmage Sedridor]] in re-discovering the incantation used to teleport to the rune essence mine, and later on provided the Zamorakian mages with access to the mine in exchange for access to the [[Abyss]] for runecrafting.

==Transportation==
To get there, you must be [[teleport]]ed by one of a few [[NPC]]s, who shouts the incantation: "Senventior disthine molenko!". There are a number of NPCs that can teleport the player to the mine. Players can either talk to these NPCs and ask to go to the mine, or right-click the NPC and click the "Teleport" option to go directly to the mine. Using any of the [[Portal (Rune essence mine)|portals]] that are located next to each essence rock will return the player back to the NPC that transported them there.

===Free-to-play===
*[[Aubury]] - The most popular and very common method of teleporting to the mine, especially for [[free player]]s, is via Aubury in [[Varrock]]. He can be found in [[Aubury's Rune Shop|his store]] just south of [[Varrock east bank]], which is a short distance away.
*[[Archmage Sedridor]] - Sedridor from the [[Rune Mysteries]] [[quest]] is located in the [[Wizards' Tower]] basement. This location is far from a bank in free-to-play, while members are able to access a bank chest in the [[Temple of the Eye (location)|Temple of the Eye]], located through the [[Portal (Wizards' Tower)|portal]] in the [[Wizards' Tower]] basement. 

===Members===
*[[Wizard Distentor]] - Although level 66 or higher [[Magic]] is required to enter the [[Wizards' Guild]], which is located in [[Yanille]], this [[members]]' location is preferred by many players due to its short distance from a bank. It is the superior location surpassing [[Aubury]].
*[[Wizard Cromperty]] - Located in [[East Ardougne]], north-east of the marketplace, this location has a fairly-medium distance from a bank. Cromperty would follow behind Distentor of the Wizards' Guild and Aubury.
*[[Brimstail]] - He is located in a cave in the south-western corner of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. This location is not recommended as it is a long way to a bank from here.

==Features==
The mine features four large essence outcrops that the player can mine from. Unlike most types of [[Mining]] rocks, multiple players can mine from the same [[essence]] rock at the same time, and a single click will have the player automatically mine until their inventory is filled with essence.

===Rune essence===
[[Free players]], or [[members]] with less than level 30 [[Mining]], will mine [[rune essence]] from the outcrops. Each mined essence gives 5 Mining [[experience]]. Rune essence can be used with the [[Runecraft]] skill to craft elemental [[runes]] ([[Air rune|air]], [[Water rune|water]], [[Earth rune|earth]], and [[Fire rune|fire]]), [[mind rune]]s, and [[body rune]]s.

===Pure essence===
[[Members]] with a [[Mining]] level of 30 or higher will start mining [[pure essence]] from the mines. Pure essence can be used with the [[Runecraft]] skill to craft all runes.

==Trivia==
* Before its removal in [[2014]], players had a chance to encounter the [[Lost and Found]] random event when teleporting to the rune essence mine.
* The rune essence mine has an unusual instancing system. When a new player enters the mines, a counter increases. When this counter reaches 5, a new instance is created. This counter is not decreased when a player leaves or logs out. The counter threshold is often increased for seasonal game modes such as Deadman Mode.{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Lykos|url=https://discord.com/channels/177206626514632704/269673599554551808/1345881081408258121|date=2 March 2025|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27962786#chat-messages-269673599554551808-1345881081408258121|archivedate=7 March 2026|quote=every time someone enters the mine on a given world, a counter goes up - once it reaches 5, a new instance is created, but it doesn't go down if a player leaves or logs out. so i guess it's just, every 5 entrances, a new instance is spawned|image=|ctxquote=|ctximage=|name=jmoddiscordmsg|group=|notes=}}
